the use of MePEG is an effective way of improving the catalytic activity of lipase B from C. antarctica in organic media, as a consequence of the additive effect on the protein hydration, flexibility and accessibility, which are all factors that contribute to increase the catalytic activity.

the addition of MePEG to the dehydrated lipase film increases its water content, improves its flexibility and accessibility and enhances its catalytic activity, thus making it a promising additive for the formulation of biocatalysts in a dry form.
